name: kill_process
description: Force-terminate a child or descendant process (equivalent to SIGKILL) when the current process has management capability. The reason is recorded in the target process result. For graceful termination use signal_process with SIGTERM; for pausing/resuming use SIGSTOP/SIGCONT; for cooperative cancellation use SIGCANCEL.

pid.description: Child or descendant PID to terminate.

reason.description: Reason recorded in the target process result.
